{{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG030 |epname=A Meditite Fight! |enva=[[Lisa Ortiz]] |java=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Yuki Matsuoka]] }} '''Shauna''' (Japanese: '''シノブ''' ''Shinobu'') is a [[non-player character]] in the [[Hoenn]]-based {{pkmn|games}} and a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. ==In the core series games== Shauna is a {{tc|Battle Girl}} who appears as one of the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s in the [[Dewford Gym]] in {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}}, their [[Generation VI]] [[remake]]s [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]], as well as in {{game|Emerald}}. In the English versions of Ruby, Sapphire, Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire, she is named '''Tessa''', whereas in the English version of Emerald, she is named '''Jocelyn'''. Due to a dubbing error, [[4Kids Entertainment]] named her "Shauna" rather than "Tessa" in {{aniseries|AG}}. This is similar to the situation that happened with [[Shelly]] and [[Tabitha]] being named "Isabel" and "Harlan", respectively. Her Japanese name is the same in the games and the {{pkmn|animated series}}. {{color2|000|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |}{{-}} ==In animation== ===History=== In {{aniseries|AG}}, Shauna first appeared in ''[[AG030|A Meditite Fight!]]'', where she challenged {{Ash}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} after she heard about him losing to [[Brawly]], her mentor. She used her {{p|Meditite}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]] and ended up losing. She told Ash and {{Ashfr}} that she was the apprentice and girlfriend of Brawly, which they found out later wasn't true after {{an|May}} asked her about it in front of him. Shauna felt really sorry about lying but Brawly forgave her. At the end of the episode, Brawly asked Shauna to be his apprentice. Shauna [[Battle judge|judged]] Ash's [[rematch]] against Brawly in ''[[AG031|Just One of the Geysers]]''. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Shauna |pkmn=Meditite |type1=Fighting |type2=Psychic |img=Shauna Meditite.png |epnum=AG030 |epname=A Meditite Fight! |vajp=Yūji Ueda |desc={{p|Meditite}} is Shauna's only known Pokémon. It first appeared in a battle against {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}, during which Pikachu was able to avoid all of Meditite's attacks. In the middle of the battle, [[Brawly]] appeared, and Meditite was recalled. Later, Shauna sent Meditite out when she wanted to finish her battle with Ash. Shauna and Meditite quickly took over the control of the battle, but suddenly Ash came up with an idea, and told Pikachu to imagine that Meditite was a wave. Using this strategy, Pikachu was able to avoid Meditite's attacks and then use {{m|Thunderbolt}} to defeat Meditite. According to Brawly, Shauna has trained with Meditite ever since she was a child. Meditite's known moves are {{m|Calm Mind}}{{tt|*|Meditate in the English dub}}, {{m|High Jump Kick}}, {{m|Detect}}, and {{m|Focus Punch}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{fighting color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=松岡由貴 ''Yuki Matsuoka'' |en=[[Lisa Ortiz]] |ar=أسمهان بيطار ''Asmahan Bitar'' |pt_br=Flávia Narciso |es_eu=Sandra Jara |es_la=Toni Rodríguez |pl=Katarzyna Łukaszyńska }} ==Trivia== * A {{tc|Crush Girl}} on [[Mt.
